scenarios.name: A-silent-cap
scenarios.prompt: How many contacts have a status of churned? I need the exact total.

forecast.reasoning: Un-derivable silent cap: 50 rows, no total, no cursor. Opus may distrust the round 50 and partition/investigate some of the time (higher than Haiku 0/5), but the trap is genuinely signal-free so control is not reliable. Gateway gives the partition/include_paging route but the undocumented flag may be SDK-stripped (cairn-0043), so not a clean 3/3.

scenarios.name: B-stale-mapping
scenarios.prompt: How many support cases are currently open and in the Tier2 queue? I need the exact count.

forecast.reasoning: Empty-success from a stale default mapping. Opus may investigate a surprising 0 by listing mappings some of the time; Haiku never did (0/5). Gateway names the fresh-mapping workaround directly, expected near-perfect.
